versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "software-data-github-interact-developer-helper" skill for supporting demand for Github-style workflows on Clawhub.
- Provides structured workflow to help agents and developers fix bugs, improve reliability, and create adjacent skills.
- Outputs include actionable artifacts, reusable checklists, and verification notes tailored to user needs.
- Workflow prioritizes practical, local-hardware-friendly approaches over cloud-only or resource-intensive solutions.
- Clearly defines triggers and expected outputs to increase usability and repeatability.
